title: Remote pcap: Store active hosts in a preference file, recent hosts in a list
description:
We shouldn't try to connect to every member of the "list
of recent rpcapd hosts" when opening Manage Interfaces.
Only try to connect to the hosts that we were recently connected to.

Store the hosts we are connected to in a preference file and
try *those* on opening ManageInterfaces. Use JSON, because
we have multiple hosts with per-host information, and then for
each host's interfaces there can be per-interface settings
(and the list of interfaces on a host can change.)
We don't store the per-interface settings now, but we might in
the future.

Keep the list of recent connections in recent_common, but don't
store every single host we've every connected to (using a
hash table.) Change it to a list, so we can know the order and
store the most recent based on a max count; use 20. Maybe this
could be a pref eventually.

We still don't store passwords, so remote hosts using passwords
won't work and will give an error message. (Cf. #17949 for
storing passwords for extcap.)

The remote hosts should also be converted from a QTreeWidget
to a QTreeView with a Model for the remote hosts eventually.

Fix #17484. Fix #8557.

commits_data.title: Qt: Store active remote hosts in a preference file
commits_data.message:
Qt: Store active remote hosts in a preference file

Store the active remote hosts in a preference file.
Use JSON because in addition to each host, we later may want
to save the per-interface settings (but the interfaces
available on a host could change without the host information
changing). Hosts and interfaces together have a tree-like data
structure that doesn't work with a UAT or other table.

Still TODO: password handling (cf. #17949 and extcap.), moving
this into a Model instead of a TreeWidget, getting rid of
remote_interface_dialog and handling all of this in
ManageInterfacesDialog through the model.

Fix #17484. Fix #8557.

commits_data.title: Make recent remote interfaces a list
commits_data.message:
Make recent remote interfaces a list

Storing every rpcapd host ever connected to in recent_common seems
unwise. Change it to a list, so we can have a max count and order.
Store the most recent 20. Maybe this could be a pref eventually.

Related to #17484.
